# Security policy

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability, exposed
credential, unsafe archive, or privacy problem. Report it privately to
`cgvviewer@gmail.com` with the affected version, impact, reproduction details,
and any suggested mitigation.

The maintainers will acknowledge a complete report as soon as practical,
investigate it, and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available. Never
include private genomic data, tokens, or credentials in a report unless a
secure transfer method has been agreed first.

Security fixes target the current CGeV Web source and the latest CGeV Desktop
release line. Older releases may require upgrading to receive a fix.
